recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-47136 unless OO later changes the vital signs profile model.
issue_request: FHIR-47136 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO request to remove Must Support from Observation.component for non-Blood Pressure vital signs profiles and add that requirement to the Blood Pressure-specific profile.
initial_application: March 2025 FHIR-47136 source commits, beginning with 983b8c8cd0 and followed by fb9f069dba, 32a93609e2, 51f56178b6, 93350bb259, and e4978f7381, applied the component Must Support move and refined Blood Pressure component slicing and constraints.
additional_context: The active Observation Vital Signs IG includes the base and specific vital signs StructureDefinitions. Existing combined-branch reconciliations for FHIR-49736 and FHIR-48427 cleaned up remaining related base-profile summary and value/result narrative text. FHIR-44721 is linked because the same source family also changed the base component.valueQuantity binding.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The base vitalsigns profile declares Observation.component and component children without Must Support, the non-Blood Pressure vital sign profiles do not mark component Must Support, and the Blood Pressure profile carries the expected component Must Support flags.

related_jiras.note: Linked Applied issue whose Jira comments say the FHIR-47136 work also changed Observation.component.valueQuantity to http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs.
